[SWS_DM_00965] Caching of monitor results
⌈
If the function ara::-
diag::Monitor::ReportMonitorAction is called and the DM is currently not
ready to process reported event qualification, the DM shall cache at least one quali-
fied PASSED and qualified FAILED result and process the qualified FAILED/PASSED,
when the daemon connection is (re-)established.
⌋
